title: Page 4
content_zh:
她不是没看出赵雪心虚，但是纵使如此又如何？自知为恶，不知回头也是枉然。

赵小丫低下头，眼也不眨的将蛋换了个碗。

当她端着木托盘走出去时正好见赵老爹进门，两父女对视了眼，赵老爹声不吭的走到墙角的水缸旁用水冲洗手脚。

赵小丫将面放在堂屋里，走出来轻唤了声，“爹，姊姊说娘亲有事进城会晚些回来。面煮好了，是姊姊亲手做的，爹快过来，趁热吃。”

赵老爹听到是赵雪下厨有些惊讶，他比任何人都知道赵雪十指不沾阳春水，这十里八村可没个闺女养得像他们赵家这么细致，就像刘彩凤说的，闺女长得好，将来有大造化，总要娇养着。

赵老爹对于有这么漂亮的闺女自然也是欣喜，只是见赵雪越大长得越好，但性子却随了刘彩凤，骨子里自私自利又凉薄，他不由得叹了口气，这性子就算真有福气嫁进好人家，也少不得吃苦头。

“你娘不在就进屋来吃。”赵老爹看着端了海碗就要往外走的赵小丫说。

赵小丫的目光看向不发言的赵雪。

赵雪这时才反应过来，笑着说道：“是啊！娘不在，小丫快坐下。”

在赵家，平时赵小丫根本不能上桌，刘彩凤的意思是她长得副穷酸样，看着她就厌恶。赵老爹不是没为此跟刘彩凤吵过，最后是赵小丫不想让赵老爹难做，乖巧的个人窝在灶房里。

“别愣着，快吃吧。”赵老爹挥了挥手中的筷子催促。

赵小丫乖乖坐下，在赵雪时不时飘向自己的目光中将海碗的面全吃进肚子里，她捂着有些撑的肚子讽刺的心想，难得今日可以吃顿饱饭。

赵雪看着赵小丫抚着肚子的模样，嘴角带着抹讥讽，果然是娘说的穷酸样，不过碗面，吃得跟饿死鬼投胎似的，没几口全塞进肚子了。

见赵雪碗面还有半，赵小丫站起身先去灶房烧火。

等她回来，赵雪已经吃完，看来她今天心情不错，食慾极好。

赵小丫手脚俐落的将桌子给收拾好，把碗筷拿到院子墙边的水缸旁洗干净。

赵雪觉得头有些发晕，轻揉太阳穴强打起精神，叫着院子里的赵小丫，“小丫，别忙，碗先搁着，我跟你聊聊。”

“等会儿。”赵小丫拉高声音对堂屋说道：“不过几个碗，很快就好，等会儿烧的水就好了，我抬进房里给姊姊梳洗。”

赵小丫的好精神令赵雪心中疑惑，但她眼皮子太重，也没有细思，“等会去你房里聊。”她没忘了，她得确定赵小丫在房里睡死了才行。

“好。”赵小丫乖巧的回应。

赵雪撑着头，觉得晕得厉害，强撑着精神等着赵小丫。

等到赵小丫忙完，走回堂屋，只见赵老爹的头也是点点的，昏昏欲睡。

赵小丫轻声说道：“爹，你累了就先进房去躺会儿，等会儿我也抬桶热水进你屋里。”

赵老爹闻言没有拒绝，他今晚本想多做点木工，趁着下次进城摆摊赚银子，但应该是田里的活儿太累，所以实在累了，想着反正刘彩凤不在，能偷懒天，就回屋去歇了。

赵小丫到了灶房没有忙着打水，而是站在炉灶前动不动的等着，直到听到赵老爹回房的声响，她才慢条斯理的回到堂屋。

赵雪只手靠在案上撑着头，已经闭上了双眼。

她知道这是迷药的效果，上辈子她不知情的吃了下药的吃食，也是昏睡到天亮才被外头的吵杂声吵醒。

对赵小丫而言，那日是场永无止境的恶梦。

被吵醒时，她旁边躺了个男人，就是傻子李虎。

她吓傻了，不知如何反应，只能任由刘彩凤颠倒黑白，让她名声尽失，在村民面前哭天喊地的把她痛打顿，最后在众人指指点点的目光底下定下亲事。

等她回神想要为自己辩解，却被刘彩凤以不孝失贞为由又狠狠的打了顿。

自从“失贞”之后，她被打得更狠了，再没有任何个村民替她说句话……她赵小丫是个失贞失节、不检点的女人。

赵小丫伸手轻摸赵雪光滑的脸，确实是个标致的姑娘，可惜心是黑的……

她抿了抿唇，不容许自己反悔，弯下腰个使劲把赵雪给背在身后。

她虽看着瘦小，但自小干活，力气自然不像般姑娘家小，背着比她高大的赵雪并不觉得吃力。

她将赵雪背到自己的房里，放到木板床上，居高临下的看着熟睡中动也不动的赵雪。

最后她轻轻叹，喃喃道：“睡吧。”像是对着赵雪也像是对自己说：“等天亮，切都不样了。”

她头也不回的转身出去，没将门给拴上，抱着双腿在灶房内选了个阴暗的角落坐下来。

天色已暗，四周片寂静，她却了无睡意，时间越晚，她的脑子益发清醒。

也不知坐了多久，外头小院子传来声响，她连忙缩着身子，大气不敢喘下。

进入院子的是刘彩凤，她的身后还跟着个妇人和个矮胖男子。

“李家嫂子，现在那丫头肯定睡死了。”刘彩凤压低声音对着身后的妇人说道：“她的房间就是灶房旁的那间，嫂子小心点跟着我，咱们先将虎子带进去。”

李大婶点了点头，等刘彩凤背过身子，她的眼神就变了味道，有着掩不去的鄙弃。

还说是城里出生，识得几个大字，见过大场面，但瞧瞧这干的都是什么事？为了银两，自己闺女的名声都不要，这还是不是人？

她心里虽不屑，嘴巴却闭得很紧，毕竟她心知肚明，要不是刘彩凤够恶毒，她家的傻儿子，李家的独苗，只怕这辈子都难讨到媳妇。

“虎子。”李大婶想起宝贝儿子，立刻转身拿着帕子将李虎嘴边的口水擦了下，轻声哄道：“等会儿你乖乖进去，在这个房里睡晚。你别怕，娘就在外头等着。”

“不要。”李虎看着黑漆漆的房间，猛烈的摇头，“我要回家，我不要睡这里。”

“虎子乖。”李大婶怕他吵醒人，连忙安抚，掏出个甜果子，“这个拿着，你听话，若乖乖去睡觉，明天娘给你买糖。”

李虎的眼睛亮，“要很多糖。”

“好，很多糖。”李大婶口答应，“娘这次不单会给虎子很多糖，还会给虎子找个媳妇陪你玩儿。”

李虎压根不懂媳妇是什么，但听到有糖吃又有得玩，立刻乐得咧嘴笑。

刘彩凤看着流着口水的李虎，只觉恶心，想到赵小丫要和这个傻子过辈子，莫名的心情又愉快起来，连忙出声催促，“时候不早了，赶紧让人进去，明日早还有得忙。”

“知道了。”李大婶带着李虎跟在刘彩凤后头进门。

怕吵醒床上的人，刘彩凤不敢点灯，指了指床的方向。

李虎虽傻，但也清楚要睡就得躺在床上，虽说这床很硬，但这时辰他也累了，躺下后没会儿功夫便呼呼大睡。

李大婶和刘彩凤见了，这才放心的从房里退了出来。

“嫂子，你也累了，快去歇会儿，天亮时咱们再过来。”

李大婶点了点头，听着刘彩凤的安排，先在堂屋暂时窝晚。

赵小丫憋着气躲在灶房，直到四周又恢复宁静她才松了口气，靠着角落的木柴，若有所思的看着窗外月移星空，原来上辈子她就是这样被算计。

她手抚兽牙手串，慢慢等着时辰流逝。

睡在堂屋的李大婶心中记挂着事，睡得并不安稳，等鸡啼叫就迫不及待的起身。

外头的天还只是蒙蒙亮，她小心翼翼的出了院子。
content_en:
It's not that she didn't see that Zhao Xue was guilty, but so what?If you know you are doing evil, it will be in vain if you don't know how to turn around.

Zhao Xiaoya lowered her head and changed the egg into a bowl without blinking.

When she walked out with the wooden tray, she happened to see Father Zhao coming in. The two father and daughter looked at each other. Father Zhao walked to the water tank in the corner without saying a word and rinsed his hands and feet with water.

Zhao Xiaoya put the noodles in the main room, walked out and called softly, "Dad, my sister said that my mother had to go to the city for something and would come back later. The noodles are ready, and they were made by my sister. Dad, come over quickly and eat them while they are hot."

Father Zhao was a little surprised to hear that it was Zhao Xue who was cooking. He knew better than anyone that Zhao Xue had nothing to do with the spring water. There was no daughter in these ten miles and eight villages who raised her daughter as carefully as the Zhao family. As Liu Caifeng said, if a daughter looks good and has great fortune in the future, she must be pampered and pampered.

Father Zhao was naturally happy to have such a beautiful daughter, but he saw that the older Zhao Xue got, the better she looked, but his temperament followed that of Liu Caifeng, and he was selfish and cold at heart. He couldn't help but sigh. Even if he was lucky enough to marry into a good family, he would still have to endure hardships.

"Come in and eat when your mother isn't here." Father Zhao said as he looked at Zhao Xiaoya who was about to walk out after taking the bowl.

Zhao Xiaoya looked at Zhao Xue who was silent.

Only then did Zhao Xue react and said with a smile: "Yes! Mom is not here, Xiaoya, sit down quickly."

In the Zhao family, Zhao Xiaoya was usually not allowed to serve at the table. Liu Caifeng meant that she looked poor and disgusted by looking at her.It's not like Father Zhao had never quarreled with Liu Caifeng about this. In the end, Zhao Xiaoya didn't want to make things difficult for Father Zhao, so she stayed in the kitchen as a good person.

"Don't be stunned, eat quickly." Father Zhao urged, waving the chopsticks in his hand.

Zhao Xiaoya sat down obediently and ate all the noodles in the Haiwan bowl while Zhao Xue's gaze drifted towards her from time to time. She held her somewhat full belly and thought sarcastically that it was rare that she could have a full meal today.

Zhao Xue looked at Zhao Xiaoya stroking her belly with a hint of sarcasm. She was indeed poor as her mother said, but she ate the bowl of noodles as if she was reincarnated by a starving ghost. She stuffed it all into her stomach in just a few bites.

Seeing that Zhao Xue's bowl of noodles was still half full, Zhao Xiaoya stood up and went to the kitchen to light the fire.

When she came back, Zhao Xue had already finished eating. It seemed that she was in a good mood today and had a great appetite.

Zhao Xiaoya neatly cleared the table and took the dishes and chopsticks to the water tank by the wall of the yard to wash them clean.

Zhao Xue felt a little dizzy, so she gently rubbed her temples to cheer up, and called Zhao Xiaoya in the yard, "Xiaoya, don't be busy, put the bowl aside for now, I'll talk to you."

"Wait a minute." Zhao Xiaoya raised her voice and said to the main room: "It's just a few bowls. It will be ready soon. The water will be boiled later. I will carry it into the room to wash my sister."

Zhao Xiaoya's good spirit made Zhao Xue puzzled, but her eyes were too heavy-eyed and she didn't think carefully, "I'll talk to you in your room later." She didn't forget that she had to make sure that Zhao Xiaoya slept to death in the room.

"Okay." Zhao Xiaoya responded obediently.

Zhao Xue held her head, feeling dizzy, so she braced herself to wait for Zhao Xiaoya.

When Zhao Xiaoya finished her work and walked back to the main room, she saw that Mr. Zhao's head was nodding and he was drowsy.

Zhao Xiaoya said softly: "Dad, when you are tired, go to the room and lie down for a while. I will also carry a bucket of hot water into your room later."

Father Zhao did not refuse when he heard this. He wanted to do more carpentry tonight and make money by setting up a stall in the city next time, but the work in the fields must have been too tiring, so he was really tired. He thought that since Liu Caifeng was not here, he could be lazy, so he went back to the house to rest.

When Zhao Xiaoya arrived at the stove, she did not rush to fetch water. Instead, she stood in front of the stove and waited. It was not until she heard the sound of Father Zhao returning to the room that she slowly returned to the main room.

Zhao Xue leaned on the case with one hand to support her head and closed her eyes.

She knew that this was the effect of drugs. In her previous life, she had unknowingly taken drugged food and fell into a coma until dawn before being awakened by the noise outside.

For Zhao Xiaoya, that day was a never-ending nightmare.

When she was woken up, there was a man lying next to her, the fool Li Hu.

She was so frightened that she didn't know how to react. She could only let Liu Caifeng confuse right and wrong, causing her reputation to be completely lost. She cried and beat her up in front of the villagers, and finally decided to get married under the eyes of everyone pointing.

When she came to her senses and wanted to defend herself, Liu Caifeng beat her severely again for being unfilial and losing her virginity.

Since she "lost her virginity", she has been beaten even more severely, and no villager has said a word for her... She, Zhao Xiaoya, is a woman who has lost her virginity, lost her virginity, and is immodest.

Zhao Xiaoya reached out and touched Zhao Xue's smooth face. She was indeed a beautiful girl, but it was a pity that her heart was dark...

She pursed her lips, not allowing herself to regret it, and bent down to carry Zhao Xue behind her back.

Although she looks thin, she has been working since she was a child and her strength is naturally not as strong as that of other girls. Carrying Zhao Xue, who is taller than her, does not feel difficult.

She carried Zhao Xue to her room, placed her on the wooden bed, and looked down at Zhao Xue, who was sleeping motionless.

Finally, she sighed softly and murmured: "Go to sleep." It was as if she was saying to Zhao Xue and to herself: "When the sun comes up, everything will be different."

She turned around and went out without looking back, without locking the door. She hugged her legs and chose a dark corner in the kitchen to sit down.

The sky was already dark and the surroundings were silent, but she was no longer sleepy. The later it got, the clearer her mind became.

She didn't know how long she had been sitting there, but there was a sound coming from the small courtyard outside. She quickly shrank down, not daring to take a breath.

The person who entered the courtyard was Liu Caifeng, followed by a woman and a short, fat man.

"Sister-in-law of the Li family, that girl must have slept to death now." Liu Caifeng lowered her voice and said to the woman behind her: "Her room is the one next to the kitchen. Sister-in-law, be careful and follow me. Let's take Huzi in first."

Aunt Li nodded, and when Liu Caifeng turned her back, her eyes changed, with disdain that could not be concealed.

He also said that he was born in the city, knew a few Chinese characters, and had seen big scenes, but look what he was doing?For the sake of silver, he doesn't even give up his daughter's reputation. Is this still a human being?

Although she was disdainful in her heart, she kept her mouth tightly closed. After all, she knew very well that if Liu Caifeng hadn't been vicious enough, her stupid son and the only child of the Li family would have had a hard time finding a wife in this life.

"Huzi." Aunt Li thought of her precious son, and immediately turned around and wiped the saliva from Li Hu's mouth with a handkerchief, and coaxed softly: "You will go in obediently later and sleep in this room late. Don't be afraid, mother is waiting outside."

"No." Li Hu looked at the dark room and shook his head violently, "I want to go home, I don't want to sleep here."

"Be good, Hu Zi." Aunt Li was afraid that he would wake anyone, so she quickly comforted him and took out a sweet fruit. "Here, take this and be obedient. If you go to bed, my mother will buy you sweets tomorrow."

Li Hu's eyes lit up, "I want a lot of candy."

"Okay, a lot of candies." Aunt Li agreed, "Not only will Mom give Huzi a lot of candies this time, but she will also find Huzi a wife to play with you."

Li Hu didn't understand what a daughter-in-law was, but when he heard that he had sweets to eat and things to do, he immediately grinned with joy.

Liu Caifeng looked at the drooling Li Hu and felt disgusted. Thinking that Zhao Xiaoya was going to spend her life with this fool, she felt inexplicably happy again. She quickly urged, "It's getting late. Let's get someone in quickly. We'll be busy tomorrow morning."

"I know." Aunt Li led Li Hu and followed Liu Caifeng through the door.

Afraid of waking up the person on the bed, Liu Caifeng did not dare to light the lamp and pointed in the direction of the bed.

Although Li Hu was stupid, he also knew that if he wanted to sleep, he had to lie on the bed. Although the bed was very hard, he was also tired at this time, and he fell asleep soon after lying down.

Aunt Li and Liu Caifeng saw her and then left the room with relief.

"Sister-in-law, you are tired too. Go and have a rest. We will come back at dawn."

Aunt Li nodded, followed Liu Caifeng's arrangement, and stayed in the main room temporarily.

Zhao Xiaoya held her breath and hid in the kitchen. She didn't relax until the surroundings were quiet again. She leaned on the firewood in the corner and looked thoughtfully at the moon and stars outside the window. It turned out that she was calculated like this in her previous life.

She held the animal tooth bracelet in her hand and slowly waited for the time to pass.

Aunt Li, who was sleeping in the main room, had something on her mind and didn't sleep peacefully. She couldn't wait to get up when the rooster crowed.

It was still dark outside, so she cautiously walked out of the yard.
